children: 631,000-barrel-per-day Galveston Bay, Texas, refinery reported a compressor trip that resulted in a unit upset and associated flaring last week, according to a filing from the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality on Monday.
The filing said the event was discovered on October 22 and that the refinery restarted the compressor, with the unit returning to normal operations on the same day.
